title: feat: update Muse Spark to 1.2
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces the existing `muse-spark-1.1` service with canonical `muse-spark-1.2` through Vercel's exact `meta/muse-spark-1.2` route.
- Keeps `muse-spark-1.1` and every existing shorthand as compatibility aliases.
- Preserves paid-only access, multiplier 1, capabilities, 1M context, prices, and no-fallback behavior.
- Adds one focused resolver test and updates the required effective-price snapshot.

Validation:
- Direct Vercel probes: text, streaming, vision, reasoning, tools, invalid media, exact usage cost, and 10 concurrent requests.
- Local Gen E2E: canonical and all aliases, `/v1/chat/completions`, `/text`, `/text/{prompt}`, catalogs, permissions, billing, cache replay, errors, and 10 concurrent requests.
- Gen focused suites: 69 tests; Enter focused suites: 378 tests; Gen and Enter typechecks pass.

gist.headline: Muse found its next spark
gist.blurb: Muse Spark now answers to its 1.2 name through Vercel’s exact route. The old 1.1 signposts are still up, because breaking everyone’s bookmarks is not an artistic medium.
gist.summary: Updated the canonical Muse Spark service to `muse-spark-1.2` via Vercel’s `meta/muse-spark-1.2` route while retaining `muse-spark-1.1` and all existing shorthands as compatibility aliases, with the same paid-only access, 1M context, pricing, multiplier, capabilities, and no-fallback behavior.
gist.impact: Developers can use `muse-spark-1.2` for the current model route while existing `muse-spark-1.1` and shorthand integrations continue to resolve exactly as before.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny museum curator or inventor carefully replacing a glowing CRT terminal label from “Muse Spark 1.1” to “Muse Spark 1.2,” while a row of small old alias signposts still leads safely to the same bright model garden. The scene represents a canonical route upgrade that preserves compatibility; use code-plants and a long scroll-like context window as symbols for the 1M context.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny curator beret, carefully hanging a glowing pixel sign reading “Muse Spark 1.2” above a retro terminal; nearby, friendly little signposts labeled “1.1” and “aliases” all point toward the same flourishing code garden and a long scroll of context. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, subtle CRT glow, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
